name: second-wind
description: A breath, an eye rest or a stretch while Claude works, sized to the wait.

pattern.title: Breathing pattern
pattern.description: What follows the opening physiological sigh: slow paced breathing (5.5 s in, 5.5 s out) or box breathing (4-4-4-4).

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: full animates the shape, gentle moves it less and less often, still shows the words only (for reduced motion).

delaySeconds.title: Delay (seconds)
delaySeconds.description: How long a turn runs before the band appears. Quicker turns never show it. 0 to 600.

eyeRest.title: Eye rest
eyeRest.description: On turns over 60 seconds, offer a 20-20-20 eye rest between breaths.

stretch.title: Stretch
stretch.description: On turns over 60 seconds, offer a one-line stretch between breaths.

movementCard.title: Movement card
movementCard.description: Every fifth long turn, offer a 'Stand up and stretch' or '10 squats' card with Did it and Skip buttons.
